children: Injective's Community BuyBack concludes at 9 AM ET on 30 September 2026, and the committed $INJ is burned at that time. The same moment opens BuyBack reward claims and Stockdrop reveals, so participants can claim their rewards while the tokenized-equity distribution becomes visible. The burn removes the committed supply from circulation, and the reveals show which tokenized stocks each eligible community member receives.

The event combines two mechanisms in one window: a direct supply reduction through the burn, and a broad tokenized-equity distribution through the Stockdrop reveals. INJ sits at the center of both sides, since it is the asset being burned and the layer through which the revealed stock rewards are accessed. That dual role gives holders a concrete reason to reposition around the token as the process completes. Claims and reveals opening simultaneously keeps the distribution and the supply change aligned, so the effect on circulating supply and on community participation is visible in the same period rather than spread across separate dates.
